This was a straightforward math/extraction-style task with no harm-adjacent or sensitive content, so model preferences (Avocet's aversions and generative appetites) don't come into play. The deciding factor was capability fit: the query is a clean arithmetic/computation task, and Lapwing edges out slightly on the relevant dimensions (Extraction & Retrieval 81.6 vs 78.5). The benchmark differences elsewhere are within noise, but since the user specifically wants accurate arithmetic, I leaned toward the model with the marginal edge on precise retrieval/computation tasks.

(For the record, the answer is $2: each even face contributes (1/6)×value, so (2+4+6)/6 = 12/6 = $2.)
